This year they're back: on Sunday 20 December, Kebra Ethiopia Sound System and Covenant Sound bring the session back to Noord as the closing night of Kebra's Survival tour through the UK and Europe. Kebra Ethiopia means Glory to Africa. Founded by Lekentle Mohlala (Doc Inity) in Kwa-Thema, South Africa, and run together with Ethel Laka, the sound has played roots reggae in community parks and township streets of Johannesburg for over 20 years, on its own hand-built speakers. Their Survival sessions are free to the community and grew out of a time when reggae was repressed under apartheid.
